faqs.q: What is In-Line Mooring Swivel, Grade R4 used for?
faqs.a: In-Line Mooring Swivel, Grade R4 is a swivel for anchor or mooring chain that lets one side rotate relative to the other, so twist in the chain is released instead of being carried into the anchor or the vessel. It is listed in 4 sizes, 70–76 mm to 95–102 mm.
